user.title: Pecron Account
user.description: Sign in with your Pecron app account. The cloud is used once to read each station's data model and local key; after that Bluetooth and Wi-Fi work without it. You choose which connections to use, and in what order, under Configure.

advanced.title: Advanced Options
advanced.description: Configure polling and other advanced settings

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password, or wrong region selected. Each region uses a different login server, so a correct email/password can still be rejected if your account is registered in a different region. If you're sure your credentials are correct, try a different region.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the Pecron API server. Check your internet connection and try again.

init.title: Connections
init.description: Each station is read over the highest-priority connection that is working. A connection that fails 3 times in a row is skipped and re-tried with increasing back-off, so a flaky link cannot cause flapping. Choose "Not used" to disable a connection entirely.

data.refresh_interval: Cloud poll interval (seconds, minimum 60 – the cloud has an account quota)
data.push_stream: Cloud push stream (live updates, no API quota)

data_description.fast_report_interval: Asks the station to report every few seconds. Each request uses 1 cloud API call (quota about 1,280 a day): 120 s = 720 a day. 0 = off.

devices.title: Station addresses and keys
devices.description: For each station (host_<id>): an optional fixed IP for Wi-Fi; leave blank to find it automatically. Optional local key (key_<id>): only needed if the key cannot be fetched from the cloud, e.g. one copied from another local tool. Stations: {devices}

error.duplicate_transport: Each connection can only be chosen once.
error.invalid_key: The local key must be the base64 text of a 16-byte key.
